The sweep removes other sessions' leftover directories here, whatever their age.

Aliases, functions, and shell options captured at startup and applied by the Bash tool to each command. Removed on clean exit. The sweep clears any left after a crash.

Earlier versions of `~/.claude.json`, copied when Claude Code rewrites the file. Claude Code keeps the five newest copies, plus a copy of any version it couldn't parse. Past the age cutoff, the last copy that holds your configuration is deleted too. If the current file parses, holds your configuration, and is under 8 MiB, you're left with a new copy of it.

Cached feature policy settings for your organization. Only present for some account types. Refreshed automatically. A `policy-limits.json.stamp.json` sidecar records which account or API key the cache belongs to. Claude Code deletes both files when you log out.
